basics.name: Trishal Adabala
basics.label: Undergraduate Student Researcher
basics.summary: B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering with a specialization in AI/ML and a minor in Mathematics at Shiv Nadar University (GPA: 9.14/10). Experienced in decentralized machine learning (HPE Swarm Learning) and systems engineering. Actively seeking PhD and Master's opportunities in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence.

projects.name: Continuous Language Flows & Sampler Control Geometry (ACL 2027)
projects.description: Investigating sampler control geometry and operating-point non-equivalence in continuous-latent flow language models.
highlights: Proved operating-point non-equivalence of classifier-free guidance (SC-CFG) and stochastic temperature (gamma) across 280 factorial runs on ELF-B/M/L and MDLM; identical (Gen-PPL, H_ps, NFE) triplets produce fundamentally divergent text.
Conducted two-way ANOVA demonstrating SC-CFG controls local 4-gram repetition (66.1%-98.3% variance) while gamma controls cross-sample corpus diversity (85.2%-91.1% variance) and MAUVE (92.5%).
Replicated findings across 6 matched-metric pairs under Satterthwaite-Welch t-tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction (p < 0.001) and TOST equivalence testing.
Formulated Encoder-Cycle Projection (ECP), an idempotent manifold retraction operator (Pi = E o D) cutting 16-step ODE perplexity by 10.7% and boosting MAUVE coherence by +53.9%.
Mathematically proved the Wave-Step Resolution Theorem (N_eff = N/W), showing continuous flows outperform discrete masked diffusion (MDLM) by 13.5x in perplexity.

projects.name: AbDev-X: Therapeutic Antibody Developability with Paired-Sequence GPs
projects.description: Machine learning framework for multi-assay clinical antibody developability prediction using paired-sequence biophysical priors.
highlights: Built paired-sequence Gaussian Process models (LOCK-GP) and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (MultKAN 2.0) across 5 clinical assays (HIC, Tm2, AC-SINS, PR_CHO, Titer) on GDPa1 (N=246) and GDPa3 (N=80).

Identified and resolved an upstream heavy-light chain subtype feature swap bug, recovering Tm2 cross-validation Spearman rho from -0.0587 to +0.3247 and lifting 5-assay mean rho from 0.3621 to 0.4242.
Implemented MultKAN 2.0 with B-spline activation functions, achieving the top held-out GDPa3 generalization (rho = 0.2556) across the benchmark.
Formulated Residual Non-Conformity Score (RNS) selective abstention, boosting out-of-distribution GDPa3 Spearman correlation from rho = 0.1650 to 0.2412 at 70% coverage.
Designed a paired heavy-light cross-attention covariance kernel in GPyTorch, outperforming uncoupled single-chain baselines by +0.062 mean rho.

projects.name: QuantPPI: Data-Oblivious Vector Quantization for Protein Embeddings
projects.description: High-dimensional geometry, signal quantization, and SIMD acceleration for 1280-D protein language model embeddings (ESM-2).
highlights: Identified extreme coordinate anisotropy (PR/D = 0.0012, >83% energy in <= 4 rogue coordinates) in ESM-2 embeddings, proving orthogonal transforms cause a 2.58x noise-inflation penalty.
Formulated and proved Support-Orthogonal Bleed Elimination and Analytical Bussgang De-Attenuation theorems, restoring unbiased inner products with zero data calibration.

Engineered multi-radix Lloyd-Max codecs (168 B - 488 B) and spherical E8 lattices surpassing trained FAISS OPQ (0.9993 vs 0.9968 Recall@20@30; 0.9600 vs 0.9180 Top-1 Recall) with 2x lower RAM and zero training time.
Implemented high-performance Asymmetric Distance Computation in C with ARM NEON SIMD vectorization (0.35 ms/query, 234k vectors/sec).
Engineered an end-to-end reproducible research platform with 420 automated unit tests and an interactive Next.js / Mol* 3D macromolecular web studio.

projects.name: VectorWing: Whole-Brain Drosophila Connectomics
projects.description: Computational neurobiology pipeline analyzing 16.8M synapses from the FlyWire FAFB v783 dataset.
highlights: Engineered an out-of-core pipeline processing 16.8M synapses from whole-brain electron microscopy under a strict <380 MB RAM ceiling on commodity hardware.

Dissected null models in connectomics, discovering that edge-swapping collapses physical reciprocity by 4.61x; designed degree-stratified conditional permutation models to isolate true chemospecific preferences.
Isolated a true +20.6% to +31.8% GABA-GABA excess in the Ellipsoid Body heading compass (Z > +13, p = 0.0005) mapping 88.2% to homotypic ring neurons.
Discovered a 2.53x to 5.92x heterotypic ACh <-> GABA reciprocity inversion in the Fan-Shaped Body with 100% strict directional chemical polarity (554 dyads, p < 0.001).
Constructed a 16-column continuous neural rate simulation demonstrating that tangential inhibitory feedback provides subtractive attenuation capping columnar firing at 30.6 Hz.
